answers.7: quarter, eighth rest, quarter rest, eighth rest
answers.8: eighth note, two eighth rests, quarter rest, eighth rest

compared_with_the_file.ours: Sorting is OURS. 8 of 24 bars (10 notes) are a printed dot not written on its note -- Sean's readings confirm the trace's claim. This does not contradict the 2.350 withdrawal, which counted only dots that already NAME a head; these dots are read as dots and never bound to a note. Tiles 5, 8, 14 redictated and now compared.

redictated.verbatim: Tile 5 is an eighth note, followed by 2 eighth note rests, followed by a dotted quarter. Tile 8 is an eighth note, followed by 2 eighth note rests, followed by a quarter note rest, followed by an eighth note rest.
